SIPD.Settings.AllowPlayerToolUse.Label: Allow players to use SIPD
SIPD.Settings.AllowPlayerToolUse.Hint: When enabled, non-GM users can open the import dialog and always use the preview. Further targets are set under "Additional player targets". By default only the GM can use the tool.
SIPD.Settings.StorageFolder.Label: Storage folder
SIPD.Settings.StorageFolder.Hint: Base folder for all images SIPD stores. Leave it empty to use the default: the world folder, or a folder in your Assets Library on The Forge. Example: assets/handouts
SIPD.Settings.PlayerActions.Label: Additional player targets
SIPD.Settings.PlayerActions.Hint: Targets players may use besides the preview. Players also need the Foundry permission "Upload Files", and "Create Journal Entries" for journal images. Their files go to clipboard-images/players and clipboard-images/shared; a GM client creates these folders. Scene, tile and map pin targets always require a GM. Token, portrait, item and journal page targets only change tokens, actors, items and journal entries the player owns.
SIPD.Settings.Language.Label: Language
SIPD.Settings.Language.Hint: Choose whether Image Paste & Drop follows Foundry or uses a fixed module language.
SIPD.Settings.Theme.Label: Dialog theme
SIPD.Settings.Theme.Hint: Choose between the warm signature look and a darker Foundry-aligned fallback.
SIPD.Settings.EnablePaste.Label: Enable clipboard paste import
SIPD.Settings.EnablePaste.Hint: React to pasted images, videos and image links (Ctrl+V) outside of text inputs.
SIPD.Settings.EnableDrop.Label: Enable drag-and-drop import
SIPD.Settings.EnableDrop.Hint: React to dropped image and video files and dropped image URLs outside of text inputs.
SIPD.Settings.DropIndicator.Label: Show the drop target while dragging
SIPD.Settings.DropIndicator.Hint: While you drag an image over Foundry, a glow shows the token, tile or sheet it will change, and a label at the cursor names the target.
SIPD.Settings.RememberAction.Label: Reuse the last chosen target
SIPD.Settings.RememberAction.Hint: If enabled, the insert dialog starts with the last successful target instead of the configured default target.
SIPD.Settings.DefaultAction.Label: Default target
SIPD.Settings.DefaultAction.Hint: Used when no previous target should be restored.
SIPD.Settings.DefaultShare.Label: Enable player sharing checkbox by default
SIPD.Settings.DefaultShare.Hint: Pre-select the option that also shows inserted content to players afterwards.
SIPD.Settings.DefaultActivateScene.Label: Activate newly created scenes by default
SIPD.Settings.DefaultActivateScene.Hint: Pre-select the option that immediately activates a newly created scene.
SIPD.Settings.DefaultNavigation.Label: Show newly created scenes in navigation by default
SIPD.Settings.DefaultNavigation.Hint: Pre-select the option that exposes newly created scenes in the navigation bar.
SIPD.Settings.MaxImageSize.Label: Shrink large images
SIPD.Settings.MaxImageSize.Hint: Images with a longer side above this size are scaled down in the browser before the upload. GIFs, SVGs and animated images stay untouched.
SIPD.Settings.ConvertWebp.Label: Save uploads as WebP
SIPD.Settings.ConvertWebp.Hint: Converts PNG and JPEG images to WebP before the upload, which usually makes them much smaller. GIFs, SVGs and animated images stay untouched.
SIPD.Settings.WebpQuality.Label: WebP quality
SIPD.Settings.WebpQuality.Hint: Higher values look better and need more space. 85 is a good balance.
SIPD.Dialog.Title: Insert Clipboard Image
SIPD.Dialog.Intro: Review the image, pick the target that matches your workflow.
SIPD.Dialog.ConfigureHint: The default target and toggle states follow your personal preferences.
SIPD.Dialog.Name: Name
SIPD.Dialog.UploadDirectoryHint: Choose or enter a folder below {root}.
SIPD.Dialog.ShareToPlayers: Also show this image to players afterwards
SIPD.Dialog.ShareHint: Useful after creating scenes, tiles, or journals when players should immediately see the result.
SIPD.Dialog.ActivateHint: Only applies when you create a brand-new scene from the imported image.
SIPD.Dialog.Navigation: Show the new scene in navigation
SIPD.Dialog.NavigationHint: Keep this on when the scene should stay easy to reach for later preparation.
SIPD.Dialog.GridDefault: Foundry's default size. Enter the size of one square or how many squares the map is wide.
SIPD.Dialog.GridMinimum: Foundry needs at least {min} px per square.
SIPD.Dialog.RecipientsHint: Nobody checked: all players see it.
SIPD.Dialog.RecipientsNone: No other player is online right now.
SIPD.Dialog.PrototypeTokenHint: Only for linked tokens. The next token placed from the actor then uses the new image too.
SIPD.Dialog.OptimizeHint: Unchecked, the original file is uploaded.
SIPD.Dialog.OptimizeHintIfSmaller: Only if that makes the file smaller. Unchecked, the original file is uploaded.
SIPD.Batch.Title: Insert Several Images
SIPD.Batch.Intro: Pick one target for all images.
SIPD.Batch.NameHint: Used for the journal entry. Images without a file name are numbered.
SIPD.Batch.Navigation: Show the new scenes in navigation
SIPD.Batch.OptimizeHint: Applies to {count} of {total} images. Unchecked, the original files are uploaded.
SIPD.Batch.OptimizeHintIfSmaller: Applies to {count} of {total} images, each only if that makes the file smaller. Unchecked, the original files are uploaded.
SIPD.Batch.Action.JournalPages: One journal entry with a page per image
SIPD.Batch.Action.TileGrid: Tiles in a grid on the current scene
SIPD.UrlFallback.Title: Image download blocked
SIPD.UrlFallback.Heading: The image could not be downloaded
SIPD.UrlFallback.Intro: The server {host} does not let Foundry download this image. Many image hosts block other sites like this.
SIPD.UrlFallback.Hint: You can use the URL directly instead. Nothing is uploaded then. The image stays on the other server and may change or disappear at any time.
SIPD.UrlFallback.Targets: A linked image works for journal pages, map pins, portraits, chat posts, showing it to players and the preview. Scene backgrounds, tiles and tokens need the same download access, and uploads need a copy, so these targets stay unavailable.
SIPD.Action.SceneBackground: Create a new scene with this image as background
SIPD.Action.SceneBackgroundCurrent: Replace the current scene background with this image
SIPD.Action.SceneForegroundCurrent: Replace the current scene foreground overlay with this image
SIPD.Action.TileCentered: Create a centered tile in the current scene
SIPD.Action.TileFit: Create a centered tile scaled to fit the current scene
SIPD.Action.TileImage: Replace the image of the tile it is dropped onto
SIPD.Action.JournalImage: Create a journal entry with an image page
SIPD.Action.JournalPage: Add an image page to the journal entry it is dropped onto
SIPD.Action.MapPin: Create a map pin with a journal entry
SIPD.Action.TokenImage: Use as image of the selected tokens
SIPD.Action.ItemImage: Use as image of the item it is dropped onto
SIPD.Action.TokenImageOf: Use as image of the token {name}
SIPD.Action.TileImageOf: Replace the image of the tile {name}
SIPD.Action.ItemImageOf: Use as image of the item {name}
SIPD.Action.UploadDirectory: Upload the image into a directory
SIPD.Action.ShareImage: Show the image to players now
SIPD.Keybindings.QuickInsert.Name: Insert the copied image without the dialog
SIPD.Keybindings.QuickInsert.Hint: Sends the copied image straight to the target the import dialog would preselect.
SIPD.Keybindings.QuickShare.Name: Show the copied image to the players
SIPD.Keybindings.QuickShare.Hint: Shows the copied image to all connected players at once, without the dialog.
SIPD.Quick.Armed: Press Ctrl+V now. The image goes straight to: {target}
SIPD.Quick.Unavailable: Not possible right now: {target}. Pick a target in the dialog.
SIPD.Drop.DialogHint: You can still change the target in the dialog
SIPD.Drop.NoDialog: Goes straight there, without the dialog
SIPD.Tip.Title: Drop it where it belongs
SIPD.Tip.BodyGM: Drop an image onto a token, a tile or an open sheet and it becomes that picture. A glow shows where it lands.
SIPD.Tip.BodyPlayer: Drop an image onto your token or an open sheet and it becomes that picture. A glow shows where it lands.
SIPD.Tip.Insert: {key} inserts the copied image without the dialog, onto what is under the mouse.
SIPD.Notification.SceneForegroundUpdated: Updated the foreground overlay of scene '{name}'.
SIPD.Notification.BatchSkipped: {count} images could not be loaded and were skipped.
SIPD.Notification.BatchUnavailable: You have no target for several images at once.
SIPD.Error.DimensionRead: The clipboard image dimensions could not be determined.
SIPD.Error.DropFetchFailed: The image could not be loaded from this URL.
SIPD.Error.UploadPermission: You do not have permission to upload files.
SIPD.Error.PlayerUploadFailed: The upload failed. A GM has to log in once after player targets were enabled so the upload folders exist.
SIPD.Error.NoScene: No scene is open on the canvas.
SIPD.Error.NoToken: Select at least one token you own first.
SIPD.Error.NoActor: Select a token or assign yourself a character first.
SIPD.Error.NoTarget: The token, tile or sheet the image was dropped onto is gone.
SIPD.Error.UnsupportedAction: This clipboard action is not supported.
SIPD.SelfTest.Title: Image Paste & Drop self test
SIPD.SelfTest.Hint: Checks the file picker, the storage folder, the targets, WebP and the upload permission of players. Run it after an update of Foundry.
SIPD.SelfTest.Problems: Self test: {problems} of {checks} checks failed. See the chat message.
SIPD.SelfTest.NewVersions: Image Paste & Drop was verified with an older Foundry than {versions}. Run the self test in the module settings to check that everything still works.
SIPD.SelfTest.FilePicker: Foundry's file picker cannot upload or create folders.
SIPD.SelfTest.Storage: The storage folder {folder} could not be created.
SIPD.SelfTest.Targets: Scenes, tiles, journals or the image popout are missing.
SIPD.SelfTest.DropTargets: Foundry no longer converts screen positions or lists open windows the known way, so drops onto tokens, tiles and sheets and the drop indicator may not work.
SIPD.SelfTest.Texts: The texts of the module are missing.
SIPD.SelfTest.Webp: This browser cannot create WebP images. Turn off the WebP conversion or use another browser.
SIPD.SelfTest.PlayerUpload: Players may use the tool, but no player role may upload files. Allow uploads in Foundry's permission settings.
SIPD.Debug.Title: Debug file
SIPD.Debug.Hint: Saves one file for bug reports about all of Sephral’s modules in this world: versions, settings and what the modules recorded, such as the latest chat messages they read. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
SIPD.Debug.Saved: Debug file {file} saved. It contains chat text and whispers, check it before you share it.
